newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes flat in slow Easter trade.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes flat in slow Easter trade.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed broadly flat at 476.25/477.50 bolivars per dollar in characteristically slow pre-Easter trade, brokers said.
The Central Bank "supplied some liquidity, but not much, the demand for dollars wasn't there," said one trader.

With most businesses shut for the week ahead of market holidays on Thursday and Friday, "There'll be little corporate demand until next week," said the trader who saw similarly quiet sessions lying immediately ahead.
The bolivar closed Friday at 476.50/477.50 per dollar.
